name: Low-Key Character Study
description: One hard key light strikes the face from a low angle and falls to true black beyond its throw — the same identity-locked person and dark wool overcoat carry through all six frames as one continuous, feature-film-restrained campaign.
lighting: Hard low-angle key, deep falloff into black
subject: person
prompt: standing in a three-quarter turn on the same seamless studio ground as the rest of the Cast set, camera positioned low and looking slightly upward, chest-up crop with the coat collar drawn up, one hard key light striking the face from a low side angle while everything beyond its throw falls to true black rather than dim grey, a single sharp practical highlight catching the eyes, natural skin texture visible only within the lit portion of the face, heavy dark wool overcoat texture at the collar, feature-film restraint
